svg.title: Source-to-KPI mind map · recorded Xyle Trace paths
svg.desc: Published source copies and exact evidence bindings feed events and population datasets, then a managed calculation, result JSON, per100k indicator and agent-reviewed claim. Coordinate and geometry inputs are separate from the numeric denominator. Public copy: machine-specific metadata removed. The recorded paths are published separately in provenance.json.

g.title: How observations were captured · run:6a649b3c5720660b artifact:a4ca2860aabc6faa
g.text: Seven real local source snapshots → managed scoped extraction → exact, non-provisional record backing.
Only seven days of events were registered. Each observation retains its checked row, index, line or cell locator.
Connectors follow recorded dependency paths; see provenance.json for the selected public view.

svg.text: DISPLAY GEOGRAPHY / SEPARATE FROM THE NUMERIC KPI
